title: Finite-factor completion and norm-resolvent convergence of the A2 summable perturbation
theory: The exact A2 incomplete tensor-product reference H_ref with local full-strip/free-link positive h_i and vacuum Omega. Omitted face weights w_f=2^(-x-y-z)/24, selected xy rows y even and x mod4 in {0,1,2}. No change to these action coefficients.
target: For coordinate anchor cube 0<=x,y,z<=L retain omitted faces O_L. Close all retained face supports under complete reference strip factors to get finite index set I_L. Construct finite-factor K_L=sum_{i in I_L} h_i+V_L and its exact exterior-reference lift H_L=K_L tensor I+I tensor H_ref,out. Prove ||H-H_L||<=epsilon_L=alpha*abs(tau)*t_L with exact omitted dyadic tail t_L, and norm-resolvent bound epsilon_L/abs(Im z)^2 for common nonreal physical energy z. Distinguish K_L finite factor count from finite Hilbert dimension, which is false.
acceptance: Independent closed-form exact tail derivations and combinatorial checks for L=0..8
All selected strip links are represented and support closure finite by proof
Proof of self-adjoint common domain and resolvent identity, not numeric sample inference
Exact boundary coefficient assignment remains unchanged
Ordinary and optimized executable exact checks, source-bound evidence

Retained wrong-model failures: discard crossing face support, use signed cancellation, omit exterior H_ref while claiming norm-resolvent convergence, scale E_star=0 or kappa=energy, call finite-factor Hilbert space finite-dimensional
limits: This is finite-factor exhaustion in the declared product representation, not literal original clipped-box convergence
No dense homogeneous or continuum conclusion
